editionLabel: English US rules · two-page folded publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: The player whose head is most in the clouds starts.
clarifications: The chosen player receives starting tile 1. This is the rulebook's playful criterion; it does not define a measurement or equate it with height.

firstPlayerRule: The person wearing the greatest number of colors starts.

editionLabel: English US competitive variation · 12-page bilingual publisher PDF
location: Cooperative rules and competitive variation setup
firstPlayerRule: In the competitive variant, whoever most recently listened to music becomes the first Leader.
clarifications: The cooperative game does not use this selection criterion: one player starts a shuffled song, and everyone chooses a cover. The Leader's tie decision in competitive play concerns album-cover voting, not a tie over who starts.

editionLabel: French rules · English summary of the four-page publisher PDF
location: Déroulement du jeu, Tour de jeu
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went to sea starts and takes the first-player token.
clarifications: This answer translates the French instruction. The publisher's English download link returned a French rulebook during this check; the edition label reflects the file actually inspected.
uncertainty: An English-language edition has not been checked against this French instruction.

firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently dreamed about robots starts and takes the phase pawn, Sun side up.
The person who most recently spent time in nature starts and receives Equity tile 1.

location: Setup and Build your Underground line
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently took the Underground is the controller for the first round.
clarifications: The controller reveals the shared Station cards. All players then draw their own line section at the same time.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a sheep plays Wilson in the first round. Wilson makes the first swapping move; the person on their left makes Shep's first move.
